title: VIVID: A Visual Harness for Agentic Video Editing
abstract: arXiv:2611.20688v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Video editing requires agents to make editing decisions grounded in audiovisual observations and precise temporal localization, and to evaluate their effects in rendered outputs. General-purpose coding agents possess strong comprehension, reasoning, and code execution capabilities, while media interaction and evidence management mechanisms tailored to video tasks can further unlock their editing potential. We introduce VIVID, a visual harness that supports multiple native coding agents in video post-production without additional model training. VIVID provides tools for on-demand video inspection, audio analysis, and transcription, and preserves observations alongside their corresponding media versions and temporal coordinates. Agents can actively retrieve these observations as they reason, perform edits using their native coding and shell tools, and inspect rendered outputs to guide subsequent revisions. translated_title: VIVID：面向智能体视频编辑的视觉框架
translated_abstract: 视频编辑要求智能体基于视听观察和精确的时间定位做出编辑决策，并在渲染输出中评估其效果。通用编码智能体具备强大的理解、推理和代码执行能力，而针对视频任务定制的媒体交互与证据管理机制可以进一步释放其编辑潜力。我们提出VIVID，这是一个视觉框架，无需额外的模型训练即可支持多种原生编码智能体进行视频后期制作。VIVID提供了按需视频检查、音频分析和转录工具，并将观察结果与其对应的媒体版本和时间坐标一同保存。智能体可以在推理过程中主动检索这些观察结果，使用其原生的编码和shell工具执行编辑，并检查渲染输出以指导后续修订。在包含100个任务的AgenticVBench上……
tldr: VIVID是一个无需额外模型训练的视觉框架，通过提供视频检查、音频分析和证据管理工具，使通用编码智能体能够自主完成视频后期制作编辑。
en_tdlr: VIVID is a training-free visual harness that enables general-purpose coding agents to autonomously perform video post-production editing by providing tools for video inspection, audio analysis, and evidence management.
